guard: the repository's bare core smoke owns its broker and proves lifecycle-scoped open-mode delivery rather than borrowing ambient state
why: The previous bare entry point required an ambient broker, omitted every channel subscription after the no-implicit-general cut, read durable membership from a registry nobody populated, and expected a new lifecycle to inherit a DM published before its activation frontier.

The repaired fixture provisions one unique space through the shipped setup seam, uses explicit live channels, and distinguishes same-lifecycle offline delivery from pre-activation exclusion before production teardown and an awaited broker exit.

mutations.name: drop the display-name length bound
mutations.expectRed: a name one past MAX_NAME_LENGTH (129) is refused naming the limit
mutations.cell: a name one past MAX_NAME_LENGTH (129) is refused naming the limit
mutations.note: The issue #375 mutant exactly: without the bound a 70,000-character name is accepted end to end and the credential it rides hangs the connect past max_control_line. The valid-name suite imports ../src/resolve.js by source path, so the mutation is seen without a build; afterRestore keeps dist consistent with the restored source per the fixture census rule.

mutations.cell: a channel one past MAX_CHANNEL_LENGTH (4097) is refused naming the limit
mutations.note: The channel twin of the name bound: one 70,000-character channel minted a 193,754-byte credential (measured on this repo), 3x past the 65536 control line, and the connect timed out at 10s. The suite imports ../src/subjects.js by source path; the refusal cell names the bound so a neighbouring rule cannot take the credit.
